plan.objective: Attack with all available attackers for lethal this combat; at least one unblocked attacker deals lethal damage to the opponent at 2 life.
plan.guidance: Current roster is Kellan 3/2 double strike, animated 3/3 vigilant Sanctuary, and 2/2 Zhao with menace; Hydra is a tapped-out 1/1 and the opponent is at 2. Kellan is already attacking and alone deals 6 if unblocked. Add Sanctuary and Zhao, then finish attackers. Hydra can block only one attacker; if it blocks Kellan, it dies and Sanctuary/Zhao remain unblocked; if it blocks Sanctuary, Kellan is lethal; it cannot block Zhao alone due to menace. Do not spend Lightning Strike or other resources before combat damage; combat itself is lethal. No mana commitments or holds are needed.

phases.guidance: Allow combat damage to resolve. The opponent is at 2 and cannot block all attackers: if Kellan is unblocked, double strike deals 6; otherwise at least one of Sanctuary (3) or Zhao (2) is unblocked. Do not cast burn or take unrelated actions before this lethal damage. If an unexpected response prevents lethal or the opponent survives, reassess immediately.
reevaluate: A response changes attackers, blockers, or damage

phases.guidance: Only if the opponent somehow survives, reevaluate visible landfall growth and whether it creates a lethal trample attack. Hydra is currently a 1/1 and its available lands are tapped; do not spend Lightning Strike without lethal urgency. If a landfall trigger would make Hydra dangerous, use Lightning Strike while Hydra is within 3 toughness and protection is not making the line futile; otherwise preserve resources and reassess survival.
reevaluate: Hydra grows or gains trample before blockers
Protection or a new reach blocker changes the race

phases.guidance: If the opponent survives and Hydra attacks, block with Sanctuary if it is still available and Hydra remains 1/1; Sanctuary kills it and survives. If Hydra has grown, calculate trample damage and block only as needed to prevent lethal, preserving other creatures when possible.

holds.purpose: Keep one Lightning Strike as the actual 3-damage answer to a Hydra growth threatening lethal on the opponent's next turn.
